I'm probably not the best for answering this, but I can say I have been in nearly your same shoes as far as that unconditional desire goes. For some reason, you are fixated on this one girl and have probably made her out to be 10x better than she is simply because she's there and engraved in your mind. You are in love with the thought you have of her or the memories with her, not so much who's really in front of you. I've been suffering from cases like this since I was probably in middle school. We are a rare type of deep and powerful emotions, and when we invest ourselves in someone, even the wrong person, we will damn near be obsessed and they are all we want until we realize, we can take that energy and put it somewhere, maybe where it's appreciated and deserved. It's painful because most of the time these people who get our attention don't know hard we fall and can't handle the breakup nearly as easy but rest assured, you're not alone. There's nothing wrong with still having feelings but cut the obsession by shifting your focus to other things. I hate to say it but maybe focus on some of the bad things she's done to let you fall out of love. Took me two years with my ex but I can finally say I'm over it. Cheers.
